prompt: Complete the static ServiceRegistry: register(name, url) stores an entry in one shared static map, lookup(name) returns the url or null, and clearAll() wipes the registry for every caller.
explanation: Because the map is static, it lives on the class itself: every method anywhere in the program that touches ServiceRegistry reads and writes the same single HashMap, which is why an entry registered in one helper method is visible from another. Map.put overwrites an existing key, and Map.get already returns null for missing keys, so lookup needs no extra branching. Shared static state is convenient but global -- tests must clean it up (clearAll) so one test cannot leak entries into the next.
hints: register maps directly onto services.put(name, url).
Map.get returns null when the key is absent -- exactly what lookup should do.
clearAll calls the map's clear() method; because everything is static, this affects every caller at once.
